title: K-flat object comparison in one commuting affine square
statement: Let A,B be commutative rings, Y,Z schemes [def-pc-scheme], and assume their scheme derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Let t:Spec A≅Y and σ:Spec B≅Z, φ:A→B and p:Z→Y with σ.hom;p=Spec φ;t.hom. Let e:D(Spec A)≌D(Y) and d:D(Spec B)≌D(Z) be specified equivalences with specified natural localization comparisons identifying their forward functors with termwise pushforward along t.hom and σ.hom. Let M be a native K-flat A-module cochain complex [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], P∈D(Y), and hP:e.inverse(P)≅Q(tilde M). Then there is an isomorphism d.functor(Q(tilde(φ* M)))≅Lp*(P), with φ* the termwise scalar extension. This is an object comparison in a single square, with no choice-coherence assertion between different squares.

source.place: Tag 08DW(2) with Tag 0D5S; core proof step 2 restricted to the bottom square

proof.text: Build the module pushforward equivalence of each scheme isomorphism explicitly from pushforward composition and identity. Localize it. The given localization comparison identifies the supplied forward equivalence with this localization by fully faithful whiskering; the inverse functors are therefore naturally isomorphic. The tensor-pullback adjunction identifies underived pullback with the inverse pushforward. Localize that inverse and use left-derived uniqueness with the counit defining derivedPullback. Thus e.inverse≅Lt* and d.inverse≅Lσ*. The Lean proof supplies all these constructions explicitly.

Compose the components of perfectHomComposition for σ.hom,p and Spec φ,t.hom with the square equality, obtaining Lσ*Lp*(P)≅Lφ*Lt*(P). Use e.inverse≅Lt*, hP, and the existing affine K-flat natural isomorphism evaluated at M to identify its right side with Q(tilde(φ* M)).
Precompose with d.inverse≅Lσ*, invert the resulting object isomorphism, apply d.functor, and compose with the counit d.functor(d.inverse(Lp*P))≅Lp*P.

theorem nonempty_affineSquareKFlatModelIso
    (A B : CommRingCat.{u}) (Y Z : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ X : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (t : Spec A ≅ Y) (σ : Spec B ≅ Z) (φ : A →+* B) (p : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hsquare : σ.hom ≫ p = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ t.hom)
    (e : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec A) ≌ schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (d : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec B) ≌ schemeDerivedCategory Z)
    (he : (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ e.functor ≅
      (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec A).toRingedSpace))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward t.hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q))
    (hd : (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ d.functor ≅
      (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward σ.hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hM : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} A) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M)
    (P : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (hP : e.inverse.obj P ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec A).toRingedSpace))
        _ _ _ _ (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec A).toRingedSpace)) (tilde.functor A))
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)) :
    Nonempty (d.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} B)
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))
        _ _ _ _ (@id (ModuleCat.{u} B ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace)) (tilde.functor B))
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M))) ≅
      (derivedPullback p).obj P)
